bundle.shortDescription: Local-first AI workspace - your data never leaves your device.
bundle.longDescription: BRUTE Runtime is a fully local, offline-first Windows desktop application for hardware-aware GGUF model inspection, fit analysis, runtime auto-tuning, and a trusted local model library. No telemetry, no accounts, no cloud, no network requests.
